title: White Sands near-Earth satellite search led by LaPaz and Tombaugh
place_text: White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

tellings.quote: That same year, a very unusual project started at White Sands Missile Range.

plain: In 1953 a very unusual project began at White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico: two scientists, Lincoln LaPaz and Clyde Tombaugh, searched the sky for unknown objects circling close to Earth, years before any human-made satellite was launched. Michels tells this himself, citing the project's final report by name but not quoting it, while talking with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel about objects she believes orbit the planet. If such objects were found, something not made by people would have been circling Earth.
